div.small: Select a group — the account code will be auto-assigned

xpath.p:
1-character prefix (e.g. "6") → Level 1 Section.
2-character prefix (e.g. "61") → Level 2 Category, auto-parented under "6".
3-character prefix (e.g. "614") → Level 3 Group, auto-parented under "61".
Parent is assigned automatically — do not set it manually.
